def ref(x, n=1024):
    out = torch.empty_like(x)
    for i in range(0, x.numel(), n):
        b = x[i:i+n]
        absmax = b.abs().max()
        s = 1.0 if absmax == 0 else absmax / 127.0
        q = torch.round(b / s).clamp(-127, 127)
        out[i:i+n] = q.float() * s
    return out
